name: Park Hyatt Doha
positioning: Park Hyatt hotel in the heart of Doha's Msheireb Downtown, steps from Souq Waqif and Msheireb Metro Station
best_for: Travelers who want a central base near Souq Waqif and the metro
Couples looking for rooftop Japanese dining and a two-floor spa

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Doha, steps from Souq Waqif and Msheireb Metro Station.
Souq Waqif is 0.65 kilometers from the hotel.
Hamad International Airport is 14.2 kilometers from the hotel.
Opus is a Mediterranean restaurant inspired by the flavors of the Mediterranean coast.
Opus has a lively open show kitchen with a wood-fired oven.
Anis is an all-day healthy eatery serving hand-made food, including gluten-free options, plus coffees, juices and smoothies.
Sora Rooftop serves small sharing dishes, sushi, tempura and robata, meat grilled over charcoal.
Sora Rooftop hosts a brunch on Fridays.
All rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, window seats and a marble bathroom with a deep soaking tub, rain shower and double vanity.
Rooms come with Le Labo bath toiletries and a Nespresso coffee maker.
Valet parking is offered for hotel guests and event visitors.
In-room dining is available 24 hours a day.

highlights.text: Sora Rooftop sits 21 storeys above Msheireb Downtown, with panoramic views of The Doha Palace, the Green Mosque, Souq Waqif, the Corniche and the Doha skyline.
The Spa spans two floors, with tailored treatments, mood showers, a hot tub, sauna, steam room and ice room.
The semi-covered pool and fitness center have dedicated spaces for women and men, with year-round swimming and views across Msheireb Downtown.
Presidential and Diplomat Suite guests have a private terrace with views over the city or the Corniche.

considerations.text: Anis offers alfresco dining on Sikkat Wadi, pitched for Doha's milder winter months.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's ultra-luxury positioning.
